entities.name: Statue Trial of Kroog
entities.description: Contest at the end of the Time of Legends in which suitors tried to move a great statue to win Kayla bin-Kroog's hand.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Daughter of the Warlord of Kroog, offered in marriage to whoever moved the statue.

entities.name: Warlord of Kroog
entities.description: Kayla's father, who set the statue trial.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer who entered the contest because of the Jalum Tome.

entities.name: Jalum Tome
entities.description: Part of Kayla's dowry that inspired Urza to participate.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Town outside which Kayla's first betrothed drowned.

entities.name: Shielded Sea
entities.description: Sea where Kayla's first betrothed's ship went down.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Town with the great statue in its square.

entities.name: Avenger
entities.description: Urza's first Avenger, a construct that moved the statue.

events.summary: Kayla's first betrothed drowns when his ship goes down in the Shielded Sea outside Korlis.
events.quote: Kayla bin-Kroog 's first betrothed drowned when his ship went down in the Shielded Sea outside Korlis .

events.summary: Urza's first Avenger moves the statue where all other contestants failed, and the king allows Urza to marry Kayla.
events.quote: All other contestants failed, but Urza's first Avenger succeeded

relations.quote: Kayla's father, the Warlord of Kroog

relations.note: Urza's first Avenger succeeded in the trial.
